entry.title: New: Resolution 725 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AWARDS A PUBLIC ACCESS, OPEN SPACE, AND NATURAL RESOURCES PRESERVATION MAINTENANCE FUND STEWARDSHIP GRANT TO FRIENDS OF AMY B. H. GREENWELL ETHNOBOTANICAL GARDEN

Approves a grant of $223,200 to Friends of Amy B. H. Greenwell Ethnobotanical Garden, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization, to preserve native plant species, repair and maintain security and storage facilities, and educate the community and visiting public of the natural and cultural resources at the Amy B. H. Greenwell Ethnobotanical Garden, South Kona, property (Tax Map Keys: 8-2-013:002, 003, 014; 8-2-014:043
